candidates.name: Whole group discriminant
candidates.description: Native PLS-LDA on the full 1280-channel group mean. Accepted reference classifier.

candidates.name: Covariance geometry
candidates.description: Log-Euclidean covariance of training-only label-free token coordinates, combined with group mean. Models correlated within-group heterogeneity rather than only channel SD.

candidates.name: Tissue composition
candidates.description: Native multiresponse PLS predicts annotated training tissue fractions; response ordering identifies each whole group.

candidates.name: Shared interface context
candidates.description: Native PLS-LDA sees a group mean and its contrast to physically shared-boundary-weighted neighbors.

candidates.name: Tile rank consensus
candidates.description: Native tile PLS-LDA rankings are pooled with exact tile-to-group area weights using Borda consensus.

candidates.name: Multiple instance attention
candidates.description: A native PLS instance head determines confidence-weighted attention within each group before its tissue evidence is aggregated.

candidates.name: Hierarchical routing
candidates.description: Training class prototypes define a binary class tree. Native binary PLS heads provide soft path evidence to every leaf.

candidates.name: Pairwise tournament
candidates.description: A native binary PLS model distinguishes each training class pair. Pairwise margins are coupled to a multiclass ranking.

candidates.name: Error correcting codes
candidates.description: A native multiresponse PLS predicts a deterministic redundant class code. Decoding uses distance to valid codewords.

candidates.name: Relational tissue embedding
candidates.description: Native PLS regresses a low-dimensional class-prototype embedding; tissue identity is decoded by proximity in that learned label space.

candidates.name: Nonlinear kernel PLS
candidates.description: The native fastPLS kernelpls RBF route models nonlinear similarity to training groups before LDA. Kernel scale is estimated on training only.

candidates.name: Orthogonal nuisance separation
candidates.description: Native OPLS removes predictor variation orthogonal to the supervised response before class discrimination.

candidates.name: Residual response boosting
candidates.description: Sequential native PLS regressors fit residual class responses; stages form an additive discriminant.

candidates.name: Source bagged subspaces
candidates.description: Multiple native PLS heads use source-group bootstrap samples and different feature subspaces; ranks are aggregated across models.

candidates.name: Local expert mixture
candidates.description: Training-only feature clusters gate specialized native PLS heads, with a global head for sparse or unseen neighborhoods.

candidates.name: Distribution quantile profiles
candidates.description: Weighted quantiles of training-only label-free token projections describe multimodal tissue groups; a native PLS head learns their identity.

candidates.name: Spatial tissue pooling
candidates.description: Physically defined interior and interface feature summaries, with spatial moments, feed a native PLS group head.

candidates.name: Image composition transport
candidates.description: A group PLS head and a separate image-composition PLS head are reconciled by soft transport over the image groups. Allows repeated tissue roles.

candidates.name: Latent class densities
candidates.description: Native PLS supplies the supervised latent coordinates; shrinkage class-specific Gaussian densities yield a generative tissue ranking.

candidates.name: Tissue verification metric
candidates.description: A native PLS verifier learns same-tissue versus different-tissue relations from training pairs, then ranks training-derived tissue prototypes.
